build-ffi: keep host build tools unstripped on macOS 27

With MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14.0 exported, the linker writes chained
fixups into host proc-macro dylibs and build scripts. rustc's release
strip pass (rust-objcopy) then leaves the string table 4-byte aligned,
and macOS 27.0.1 refuses to load those dylibs ("mis-aligned LINKEDIT
string pool"). A fresh build fails with "can't find crate for
thiserror_impl".

Set CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_BUILD_OVERRIDE_STRIP=false so host tools keep
their symbols and load. rustc reads the deployment target only from the
environment, so the 14.0 floor cannot be limited to the two cross
targets.

The shipped static library is unchanged. Its objects still target
macOS 14.0 on both architectures.
